questions.question: At City Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Annelie Minny) and #2 (Susan Benade) six-hitters (combined T20 + List A) in the 08/09 season?
questions.explanation: Annelie Minny: 6 — Susan Benade: 3 — a gap of 3.

questions.question: At which ground did Zizipho Mdebuka record their career-best innings (66*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2022/11/27.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches as Captain' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 119.

questions.question: Who scored South Africa Women's first-ever ODI century, 101 not out against Ireland in December 2000?
questions.explanation: Olivier's century came during South Africa's early years back in international cricket after readmission in 1997.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.
